# JSON:API

Source: https://api-platform.com/docs/core/jsonapi/

# JSON:API

API Platform supports the [JSON:API](https://jsonapi.org) format. When a client sends a request with
an `Accept: application/vnd.api+json` header, API Platform serializes responses following the
JSON:API specification.

For details on enabling formats, see [content negotiation](content-negotiation.md).

## Entity Identifiers as Resource IDs

Since API Platform 5.0, entity identifiers are used as the `id` field of JSON:API resource objects
by default (`use_iri_as_id` defaults to `false`). If you are upgrading from an earlier version and
relied on the previous default (the IRI as the JSON:API `id`), see the
[upgrade guide](upgrade-guide.md) for the migration path.

```yaml
# config/packages/api_platform.yaml
api_platform:
    jsonapi:
        use_iri_as_id: false # the default since API Platform 5.0
```

With this configuration, the JSON:API `id` field contains the entity identifier (e.g., `"10"`)
instead of the full IRI (e.g., `"/dummies/10"`). A `links.self` field is added to each resource
object for navigation:

```json
{
    "data": {
        "id": "10",
        "type": "Dummy",
        "links": {
            "self": "/dummies/10"
        },
        "attributes": {
            "name": "Dummy #10"
        },
        "relationships": {
            "relatedDummy": {
                "data": {
                    "id": "1",
                    "type": "RelatedDummy"
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

Relationships reference related resources by entity identifier and `type`.

### Composite Identifiers

Resources with composite identifiers use a semicolon-separated string as the `id` value (e.g.,
`"field1=val1;field2=val2"`).

### Resources Without a Standalone Item Endpoint

API Platform must resolve the IRI for any resource that appears in a relationship. If a resource has
no standalone `GET` item endpoint (for example, it is only exposed as a subresource), IRI resolution
fails.

Use the `NotExposed` operation to register a URI template for internal IRI resolution without
exposing a public endpoint. A `NotExposed` operation registers the route internally but returns a
`404` response when accessed directly:

```php
<?php

namespace App\Entity;

use ApiPlatform\Metadata\NotExposed;

#[NotExposed(uriTemplate: '/tags/{id}')]
class Tag
{
    public int $id;
    public string $label;
}
```

This allows a parent resource to reference `Tag` objects in its relationships while `Tag` itself has
no public item endpoint. The `NotExposed` operation requires a `uriTemplate` with a single URI
variable.

## Client-Generated IDs

The
[JSON:API specification allows clients to supply their own `id` on `POST`](https://jsonapi.org/format/#crud-creating-client-ids)
when the server agrees to accept it. This is useful when the client generates a UUID before sending
the request and needs the server to persist it as-is.

By default, API Platform rejects client-supplied `data.id` on `POST` with a `400` response. Enable
it explicitly when needed.

### Enabling Globally

**Symfony:**

```yaml
# config/packages/api_platform.yaml
api_platform:
    jsonapi:
        allow_client_generated_id: true
```

**Laravel** (`config/api-platform.php`):

```php
'jsonapi' => [
    'allow_client_generated_id' => true,
],
```

### Enabling Per Operation

Use the `denormalizationContext` on the `#[Post]` operation to enable the feature for a single
endpoint without affecting the rest of the API:

```php
<?php

namespace App\ApiResource;

use ApiPlatform\JsonApi\Serializer\ItemNormalizer;
use ApiPlatform\Metadata\ApiResource;
use ApiPlatform\Metadata\Get;
use ApiPlatform\Metadata\Post;

#[ApiResource(
    formats: ['jsonapi' => ['application/vnd.api+json']],
    operations: [
        new Get(uriTemplate: '/books/{id}'),
        new Post(
            uriTemplate: '/books',
            denormalizationContext: [ItemNormalizer::ALLOW_CLIENT_GENERATED_ID => true],
        ),
    ],
)]
class Book
{
    public ?string $id = null;
    public string $title = '';
}
```

A request that supplies `data.id` is then accepted:

```http
POST /api/books HTTP/1.1
Accept: application/vnd.api+json
Content-Type: application/vnd.api+json

{
    "data": {
        "type": "Book",
        "id": "01932b4c-a3f1-7b7e-9e5b-3d8f1c2e4a6d",
        "attributes": {
            "title": "Hyperion"
        }
    }
}
```

The supplied `id` is passed to the entity's `id` setter. The processor is responsible for persisting
it. The response output schema still requires `id`; only the `POST` input schema marks it as
optional.


---

# Pagination Source: https://api-platform.com/docs/core/pagination/ # Pagination


Watch the Pagination screencast

API Platform has native support for paged collections. Pagination is enabled by default for all collections. Each collection contains 30 items per page. The activation of the pagination and the number of elements per page can be configured from: - the server-side (globally or per resource) - the client-side, via a custom GET parameter (disabled by default) When issuing a `GET` request on a collection containing more than 1 page (here `/books`), a [Hydra collection](https://www.hydra-cg.com/spec/latest/core/#collections) is returned. It's a valid JSON(-LD) document containing items of the requested page and metadata. ```json { "@context": "/contexts/Book", "@id": "/books", "@type": "Collection", "member": [ { "@id": "/books/1", "@type": "https://schema.org/Book", "name": "My awesome book" }, { "_": "Other items in the collection..." } ], "totalItems": 50, "view": { "@id": "/books?page=1", "@type": "PartialCollectionView", "first": "/books?page=1", "last": "/books?page=2", "next": "/books?page=2" } } ``` Hypermedia links to the first, the last, previous and the next page in the collection are displayed as well as the number of total items in the collection. The name of the page parameter can be changed with the following configuration: ## Changing page parameter name with Symfony ```yaml # api/config/packages/api_platform.yaml api_platform: collection: pagination: page_parameter_name: _page ``` ## Changing page parameter name with Laravel ```php [ 'pagination' => [ 'page_parameter_name' => '_page', ] ], ]; ``` ## Disabling the Pagination Paginating collections is generally accepted as a good practice. It allows browsing large collections without too much overhead as well as preventing [DOS attacks](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Denial-of-service_attack). However, for small collections, it can be convenient to fully disable the pagination. ### Disabling the Pagination Globally #### Disabling the Pagination Globally with Symfony The pagination can be disabled for all resources using this configuration: ```yaml # api/config/packages/api_platform.yaml api_platform: defaults: pagination_enabled: false ``` #### Disabling the Pagination Globally with Laravel The pagination can be disabled for all resources using this configuration: ```php [ 'pagination_enabled' => false, ], ]; ``` ### Disabling the Pagination For a Specific Resource It can also be disabled for a specific resource: ```php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace ApiPlatform\JsonApi\State;

use ApiPlatform\JsonApi\Util\ResourceLinkageResolver;
use ApiPlatform\Metadata\Operation;
use ApiPlatform\Metadata\Property\Factory\PropertyMetadataFactoryInterface;
use ApiPlatform\Metadata\Property\Factory\PropertyNameCollectionFactoryInterface;
use ApiPlatform\Metadata\Resource\Factory\ResourceMetadataCollectionFactoryInterface;
use ApiPlatform\State\ProviderInterface;
use ApiPlatform\State\Util\RequestParser;

final class JsonApiProvider implements ProviderInterface
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly ProviderInterface $decorated,
        private readonly PropertyNameCollectionFactoryInterface $propertyNameCollectionFactory,
        private readonly PropertyMetadataFactoryInterface $propertyMetadataFactory,
        private readonly ResourceMetadataCollectionFactoryInterface $resourceMetadataCollectionFactory,
        private readonly ResourceLinkageResolver $resourceLinkageResolver,
        private readonly string $orderParameterName = 'order',
    ) {
    }

    public function provide(Operation $operation, array $uriVariables = [], array $context = []): object|array|null
    {
        $request = $context['request'] ?? null;

        if (!$request || 'jsonapi' !== $request->getRequestFormat()) {
            return $this->decorated->provide($operation, $uriVariables, $context);
        }

        $filters = $request->attributes->get('_api_filters', []);
        $queryParameters = $request->query->all();
        $orderParameter = $queryParameters['sort'] ?? null;

        if (
            null !== $orderParameter
            && !\is_array($orderParameter)
        ) {
            $orderParametersArray = explode(',', (string) $orderParameter);
            $transformedOrderParametersArray = [];

            foreach ($orderParametersArray as $orderParameter) {
                $sorting = 'asc';

                if ('-' === ($orderParameter[0] ?? null)) {
                    $sorting = 'desc';
                    $orderParameter = substr($orderParameter, 1);
                }

                $transformedOrderParametersArray[$orderParameter] = $sorting;
            }

            $filters[$this->orderParameterName] = $transformedOrderParametersArray;
        }

        $filterParameter = $queryParameters['filter'] ?? null;
        if (
            $filterParameter
            && \is_array($filterParameter)
        ) {
            $filters = array_merge($filterParameter, $filters);
        }

        $pageParameter = $queryParameters['page'] ?? null;
        if (
            \is_array($pageParameter)
        ) {
            $filters = array_merge($pageParameter, $filters);
        }

        foreach (['page', 'itemsPerPage', 'pagination', 'partial'] as $paginationParameter) {
            if (isset($queryParameters[$paginationParameter]) && !\is_array($queryParameters[$paginationParameter]) && !isset($filters[$paginationParameter])) {
                $filters[$paginationParameter] = $queryParameters[$paginationParameter];
            }
        }

        [$included, $properties] = $this->transformFieldsetsParameters($queryParameters, $operation);

        if ($properties) {
            $request->attributes->set('_api_filter_property', $properties);
        }

        if ($included) {
            $request->attributes->set('_api_included', $included);
        }

        if ($filters) {
            // ReadProvider skips its raw-query fallback when _api_filters is set,
            // so preserve flat custom params here too. JSON:API transforms win.
            $rawParams = $request->attributes->get('_api_query_parameters');
            if (null === $rawParams) {
                $queryString = RequestParser::getQueryString($request);
                $rawParams = $queryString ? RequestParser::parseRequestParams($queryString) : [];
                $request->attributes->set('_api_query_parameters', $rawParams);
            }
            // Drop keys already consumed above so the raw bracket variants don't override the hoisted values.
            $consumed = array_diff_key($rawParams, array_flip(['filter', 'page', 'itemsPerPage', 'pagination', 'partial', 'include', 'fields']));
            $filters = array_replace($consumed, $filters);

            $request->attributes->set('_api_filters', $filters);
        }

        return $this->decorated->provide($operation, $uriVariables, $context);
    }

    private function transformFieldsetsParameters(array $queryParameters, Operation $operation): array
    {
        $includeParameter = $queryParameters['include'] ?? null;
        $fieldsParameter = $queryParameters['fields'] ?? null;

        $includeParameter = \is_string($includeParameter) ? explode(',', $includeParameter) : [];
        if (!$fieldsParameter) {
            return [$includeParameter, []];
        }

        $resourceShortName = $operation->getShortName() ?? '';
        // Per the JSON:API spec, fields[TYPE] takes a resource TYPE while include takes a relation NAME.

        $properties = [];
        $included = [];
        foreach ($fieldsParameter as $resourceType => $fields) {
            $fields = explode(',', (string) $fields);

                $properties = array_merge($properties, $fields);
            } elseif (\in_array($resourceType, $includeParameter, true)) {
                $properties[$resourceType] = $fields;
                $included[] = $resourceType;
            } elseif (null !== ($relationPath = $includedRelationTypes[$resourceType] ?? null)) {

                $properties[explode('.', $relationPath, 2)[0]] = $fields;
                $included[] = $relationPath;

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace ApiPlatform\JsonApi\Serializer;

use ApiPlatform\Metadata\Resource\Factory\ResourceMetadataCollectionFactoryInterface;
use ApiPlatform\Metadata\ResourceClassResolverInterface;
use ApiPlatform\Metadata\Util\IriHelper;
use ApiPlatform\Serializer\AbstractCollectionNormalizer;
use Symfony\Component\Serializer\Exception\UnexpectedValueException;

/**
 * Normalizes collections in the JSON API format.
 *
 * @author Kevin Dunglas <dunglas@gmail.com>
 * @author Hamza Amrouche <hamza@les-tilleuls.coop>
 * @author Baptiste Meyer <baptiste.meyer@gmail.com>
 */
final class CollectionNormalizer extends AbstractCollectionNormalizer
{
    public const FORMAT = 'jsonapi';

    public function __construct(ResourceClassResolverInterface $resourceClassResolver, string $pageParameterName, ResourceMetadataCollectionFactoryInterface $resourceMetadataFactory)
    {
        parent::__construct($resourceClassResolver, $pageParameterName, $resourceMetadataFactory);
    }

    /**
     * {@inheritdoc}
     */
    protected function getPaginationData(iterable $object, array $context = []): array
    {
        [$paginator, $paginated, $currentPage, $itemsPerPage, $lastPage, $pageTotalItems, $totalItems] = $this->getPaginationConfig($object, $context);
        $parsed = IriHelper::parseIri($context['uri'] ?? '/', $this->pageParameterName);

        $operation = $context['operation'] ?? $this->getOperation($context);
        $urlGenerationStrategy = $operation->getUrlGenerationStrategy();

        $data = [
            'links' => [
                'self' => IriHelper::createIri($parsed['parts'], $parsed['parameters'], $this->pageParameterName, $paginated ? $currentPage : null, $urlGenerationStrategy),
            ],
        ];

        if ($paginated) {
            if (null !== $lastPage) {
                $data['links']['first'] = IriHelper::createIri($parsed['parts'], $parsed['parameters'], $this->pageParameterName, 1., $urlGenerationStrategy);
                $data['links']['last'] = IriHelper::createIri($parsed['parts'], $parsed['parameters'], $this->pageParameterName, $lastPage, $urlGenerationStrategy);
            }

            if (1. !== $currentPage) {
                $data['links']['prev'] = IriHelper::createIri($parsed['parts'], $parsed['parameters'], $this->pageParameterName, $currentPage - 1., $urlGenerationStrategy);
            }

            if (null !== $lastPage && $currentPage !== $lastPage || null === $lastPage && $pageTotalItems >= $itemsPerPage) {
                $data['links']['next'] = IriHelper::createIri($parsed['parts'], $parsed['parameters'], $this->pageParameterName, $currentPage + 1., $urlGenerationStrategy);
            }
        }

        if (null !== $totalItems) {
            $data['meta']['totalItems'] = $totalItems;
        }

        if ($paginator) {
            $data['meta']['itemsPerPage'] = (int) $itemsPerPage;
            $data['meta']['currentPage'] = (int) $currentPage;
        }

        return $data;
    }

    /**
     * {@inheritdoc}
     *
     * @throws UnexpectedValueException
     */
    protected function getItemsData(iterable $object, ?string $format = null, array $context = []): array
    {
        $data = [
            'data' => [],
        ];

        foreach ($object as $obj) {
            $item = $this->normalizer->normalize($obj, $format, $context);
            if (!\is_array($item)) {
                throw new UnexpectedValueException('Expected item to be an array');
            }

            if (!isset($item['data'])) {
                throw new UnexpectedValueException('The JSON API document must contain a "data" key.');
            }

            $data['data'][] = $item['data'];

            if (isset($item['included'])) {
                $data['included'] = array_values(array_unique(array_merge($data['included'] ?? [], $item['included']), \SORT_REGULAR));
            }
        }

        return $data;
    }
}

        private readonly ResourceLinkageResolver $resourceLinkageResolver,
        private readonly string $orderParameterName = 'order',
    ) {

    public function provide(Operation $operation, array $uriVariables = [], array $context = []): object|array|null
    {
        $request = $context['request'] ?? null;

        if (!$request || 'jsonapi' !== $request->getRequestFormat()) {
            return $this->decorated->provide($operation, $uriVariables, $context);
        }

        $filters = $request->attributes->get('_api_filters', []);
        $queryParameters = $request->query->all();
        $orderParameter = $queryParameters['sort'] ?? null;

        if (
            null !== $orderParameter
            && !\is_array($orderParameter)
        ) {
            $orderParametersArray = explode(',', (string) $orderParameter);
            $transformedOrderParametersArray = [];

            foreach ($orderParametersArray as $orderParameter) {
                $sorting = 'asc';

                if ('-' === ($orderParameter[0] ?? null)) {
                    $sorting = 'desc';
                    $orderParameter = substr($orderParameter, 1);
                }

                $transformedOrderParametersArray[$orderParameter] = $sorting;
            }

            $filters[$this->orderParameterName] = $transformedOrderParametersArray;
        }

        $filterParameter = $queryParameters['filter'] ?? null;
        if (
            $filterParameter
            && \is_array($filterParameter)
        ) {
            $filters = array_merge($filterParameter, $filters);
        }

        $pageParameter = $queryParameters['page'] ?? null;
        if (
            \is_array($pageParameter)
        ) {
            $filters = array_merge($pageParameter, $filters);
        }

        foreach (['page', 'itemsPerPage', 'pagination', 'partial'] as $paginationParameter) {
            if (isset($queryParameters[$paginationParameter]) && !\is_array($queryParameters[$paginationParameter]) && !isset($filters[$paginationParameter])) {
                $filters[$paginationParameter] = $queryParameters[$paginationParameter];
            }
        }

        if ($properties) {
            $request->attributes->set('_api_filter_property', $properties);
        }

        if ($included) {
            $request->attributes->set('_api_included', $included);
        }

        if ($filters) {
            // ReadProvider skips its raw-query fallback when _api_filters is set,
            // so preserve flat custom params here too. JSON:API transforms win.
            $rawParams = $request->attributes->get('_api_query_parameters');

                $queryString = RequestParser::getQueryString($request);
                $rawParams = $queryString ? RequestParser::parseRequestParams($queryString) : [];
                $request->attributes->set('_api_query_parameters', $rawParams);

    private function transformFieldsetsParameters(array $queryParameters, Operation $operation): array
    {
        $includeParameter = $queryParameters['include'] ?? null;
        $fieldsParameter = $queryParameters['fields'] ?? null;

        $includeParameter = \is_string($includeParameter) ? explode(',', $includeParameter) : [];
        if (!$fieldsParameter) {
            return [$includeParameter, []];

        $properties = [];
        $included = [];
        foreach ($fieldsParameter as $resourceType => $fields) {

# Creating Custom Operations and Symfony Controllers

Source: https://api-platform.com/docs/symfony/controllers/

# Creating Custom Operations and Symfony Controllers

> [!NOTE] Using custom Symfony controllers with API Platform is **discouraged**. Also, GraphQL is
> **not supported**.
> [For most use cases, better extension points, working both with REST and GraphQL, are available](../core/design.md).
> We recommend to use
> [System providers and processors](../core/extending.md#system-providers-and-processors) to extend
> API Platform internals.

API Platform can leverage the Symfony routing system to register custom operations related to custom
controllers. Such custom controllers can be any valid
[Symfony controller](https://symfony.com/doc/current/controller.html), including standard Symfony
controllers extending the
[`Symfony\Bundle\FrameworkBundle\Controller\AbstractController`](https://symfony.com/doc/current/controller.html#the-base-controller-class-services)
helper class.

To enable this feature use `use_symfony_listeners: true` in your `api_platform` configuration file:

```yaml
api_platform:
    title: "My Dummy API"
    description: |
        This is a test API.
        Made with love
    use_symfony_listeners: true
```

However, API Platform recommends to use **action classes** instead of typical Symfony controllers.
Internally, API Platform implements the [Action-Domain-Responder](https://github.com/pmjones/adr)
pattern (ADR), a web-specific refinement of
[MVC](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Model%E2%80%93view%E2%80%93controller).

The API Platform Symfony variant also eases the implementation of the ADR pattern: it automatically
registers action classes stored in `api/src/Controller` as autowired services.

The entity is retrieved in the `__invoke` method thanks to a dedicated argument resolver.

When using `GET`, the `__invoke()` method parameter will receive the identifier and should be called
the same as the resource identifier. So for the path `/user/{uuid}/bookmarks`, you must use
`__invoke(string $uuid)`.

Services (`$bookPublishingHandler` here) are automatically injected thanks to the autowiring
feature. You can type-hint any service you need and it will be autowired too.

The `__invoke` method of the action is called when the matching route is hit. It can return either
an instance of `Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response` (that will be displayed to the client
immediately by the Symfony kernel) or, like in this example, an instance of an entity mapped as a
resource (or a collection of instances for collection operations). In this case, the entity will
pass through [all built-in event listeners](../core/events.md#built-in-event-listeners) of API
Platform. It will be automatically validated, persisted and serialized in JSON-LD. Then the Symfony
kernel will send the resulting document to the client.

The routing has not been configured yet because we will add it at the resource configuration level:

```php
namespace App\Entity;

use ApiPlatform\Metadata\ApiResource;

use ApiPlatform\Metadata\Post;
use App\Controller\CreateBookPublication;

#[ApiResource(operations: [
    new Get(),
    new Post(
        name: 'publication',
        uriTemplate: '/books/{id}/publication',
        controller: CreateBookPublication::class
    )
])]
class Book
{
    // ...
}
```

Source: https://api-platform.com/docs/symfony/controllers/

# Creating Custom Operations and Symfony Controllers

> [!NOTE] Using custom Symfony controllers with API Platform is **discouraged**. Also, GraphQL is
> **not supported**.
> [For most use cases, better extension points, working both with REST and GraphQL, are available](../core/design.md).
> We recommend to use
> [System providers and processors](../core/extending.md#system-providers-and-processors) to extend
> API Platform internals.

API Platform can leverage the Symfony routing system to register custom operations related to custom
controllers. Such custom controllers can be any valid
[Symfony controller](https://symfony.com/doc/current/controller.html), including standard Symfony
controllers extending the
[`Symfony\Bundle\FrameworkBundle\Controller\AbstractController`](https://symfony.com/doc/current/controller.html#the-base-controller-class-services)
helper class.

To enable this feature use `use_symfony_listeners: true` in your `api_platform` configuration file:

```yaml
api_platform:
    title: "My Dummy API"
    description: |
        This is a test API.
        Made with love
    use_symfony_listeners: true
```

However, API Platform recommends to use **action classes** instead of typical Symfony controllers.
Internally, API Platform implements the [Action-Domain-Responder](https://github.com/pmjones/adr)
pattern (ADR), a web-specific refinement of
[MVC](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Model%E2%80%93view%E2%80%93controller).

The API Platform Symfony variant also eases the implementation of the ADR pattern: it automatically
registers action classes stored in `api/src/Controller` as autowired services.

The entity is retrieved in the `__invoke` method thanks to a dedicated argument resolver.

When using `GET`, the `__invoke()` method parameter will receive the identifier and should be called
the same as the resource identifier. So for the path `/user/{uuid}/bookmarks`, you must use
`__invoke(string $uuid)`.

Services (`$bookPublishingHandler` here) are automatically injected thanks to the autowiring
feature. You can type-hint any service you need and it will be autowired too.

The `__invoke` method of the action is called when the matching route is hit. It can return either
an instance of `Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response` (that will be displayed to the client
immediately by the Symfony kernel) or, like in this example, an instance of an entity mapped as a
resource (or a collection of instances for collection operations). In this case, the entity will
pass through [all built-in event listeners](../core/events.md#built-in-event-listeners) of API
Platform. It will be automatically validated, persisted and serialized in JSON-LD. Then the Symfony
kernel will send the resulting document to the client.

```php
<?php
```
declare(strict_types=1);
namespace ApiPlatform\State\Processor;
final class RespondProcessor implements ProcessorInterface, StopwatchAwareInterface
{
    use HttpResponseHeadersTrait;
    use HttpResponseStatusTrait;
    use StopwatchAwareTrait;
    public function __construct(
        ?IriConverterInterface $iriConverter = null,
        ?ResourceClassResolverInterface $resourceClassResolver = null,
        ?OperationMetadataFactoryInterface $operationMetadataFactory = null,
        ?ResourceMetadataCollectionFactoryInterface $resourceMetadataCollectionFactory = null,
    ) {
        $this->iriConverter = $iriConverter;
        $this->resourceClassResolver = $resourceClassResolver;
        $this->operationMetadataFactory = $operationMetadataFactory;
        $this->resourceMetadataCollectionFactory = $resourceMetadataCollectionFactory;
    }
    public function process(mixed $data, Operation $operation, array $uriVariables = [], array $context = [])
    {
        if ($data instanceof Response || !$operation instanceof HttpOperation) {
            return $data;
        }
        if (!($request = $context['request'] ?? null)) {
            return $data;
        }
        $this->stopwatch?->start('api_platform.processor.respond');
        $status = $this->getStatus($request, $operation, $context);
        $headers = $this->getHeaders($request, $operation, $context);
        $this->stopwatch?->stop('api_platform.processor.respond');
        return new Response(
            $data,
            $status,
            $headers
        );
    }
}

final class JsonApiException extends \RuntimeException
{
    /**
     * @param list<array<string, mixed>> $errors
     */
    public function __construct(
        public readonly int $status,
        public readonly array $errors,
    ) {
        parent::__construct($errors[0]['detail'] ?? 'Error');
    }

    public static function single(int $status, string $title, string $detail, ?string $pointer = null, ?string $parameter = null): self
    {
        return new self($status, [self::error($status, $title, $detail, $pointer, $parameter)]);
    }

    public static function badRequest(string $detail, ?string $parameter = null): self
    {
        return self::single(400, 'Bad Request', $detail, null, $parameter);
    }

    /**
     * @param list<array{pointer: string, detail: string}> $violations
     */
    public static function unprocessable(array $violations): self
    {
        return new self(422, array_map(
            static fn (array $violation): array => self::error(422, 'Unprocessable Entity', $violation['detail'], $violation['pointer']),
            $violations,
        ));
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public static function error(int $status, string $title, string $detail, ?string $pointer = null, ?string $parameter = null): array
    {
        $error = ['status' => (string) $status, 'title' => $title, 'detail' => $detail];

        if (null !== $pointer) {
            $error['source'] = ['pointer' => $pointer];
        } elseif (null !== $parameter) {
            $error['source'] = ['parameter' => $parameter];
        }

        return $error;
    }
}

use Symfony\Component\HttpKernel\Event\ExceptionEvent;
use Symfony\Component\HttpKernel\Exception\HttpExceptionInterface;
use Symfony\Component\HttpKernel\KernelEvents;

/**
 * Renders the errors of the API as JSON:API error documents.
 */
#[AsEventListener(event: KernelEvents::EXCEPTION, priority: 128)]
final class ErrorListener
{
    private const API_PATH = '#^/(books|authors|purchases|reports|openapi\.json)(/|$)#';

    public function __invoke(ExceptionEvent $event): void
    {
        if (!preg_match(self::API_PATH, $event->getRequest()->getPathInfo())) {
            return;
        }

        $throwable = $event->getThrowable();

        if ($throwable instanceof JsonApiException) {
            $status = $throwable->status;
            $errors = $throwable->errors;
        } elseif ($throwable instanceof HttpExceptionInterface) {
            $status = $throwable->getStatusCode();
            $errors = [JsonApiException::error($status, Response::$statusTexts[$status] ?? 'Error', $throwable->getMessage() ?: (Response::$statusTexts[$status] ?? 'Error'))];
        } else {
            $status = 500;
            $errors = [JsonApiException::error(500, 'Internal Server Error', 'An unexpected error occurred.')];
        }

        $event->setResponse(new JsonResponse(['errors' => $errors], $status, ['Content-Type' => 'application/vnd.api+json']));
        $event->stopPropagation();
    }
}

/**
 * Identifies the customer of the purchase endpoints from the Customer-Id header,
 * before routing and before anything else.
 */
#[AsEventListener(event: KernelEvents::REQUEST, priority: 64)]
final class CustomerIdentificationListener
{
    public const ATTRIBUTE = '_customer_id';

    public function __construct(private readonly Connection $connection)
    {
    }

    public function __invoke(RequestEvent $event): void
    {
        if (!$event->isMainRequest()) {
            return;
        }

        $request = $event->getRequest();
        if (!preg_match('#^/purchases(/|$)#', $request->getPathInfo())) {
            return;
        }

        $header = (string) $request->headers->get('Customer-Id', '');
        if (!preg_match('/^\d{1,18}$/', $header) || !$this->customerExists((int) $header)) {
            throw JsonApiException::single(401, 'Unauthorized', 'A valid Customer-Id header is required.');
        }

        $request->attributes->set(self::ATTRIBUTE, (int) $header);
    }

    private function customerExists(int $id): bool
    {
        return false !== $this->connection->fetchOne('SELECT 1 FROM customer WHERE id = ?', [$id]);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\JsonApi;

use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Request;

/**
 * Reads the JSON:API query parameters: page, sort, include, dates.
 */
final class Query
{
    public const DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE = 10;
    public const MAX_PAGE_SIZE = 50;

    /**
     * @return array{int, int} the page number (from 1) and the page size
     */
    public static function page(Request $request): array
    {
        $page = $request->query->all('page');

        $number = self::integer($page, 'number', 'page[number]', 1, \PHP_INT_MAX) ?? 1;
        $size = self::integer($page, 'size', 'page[size]', 1, self::MAX_PAGE_SIZE) ?? self::DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE;

        return [$number, $size];
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, string> $fields the sortable fields, by name
     *
     * @return list<array{string, 'ASC'|'DESC'}> the field, as a key of $fields, and its direction
     */
    public static function sort(Request $request, array $fields): array
    {
        $value = $request->query->get('sort');
        if (null === $value) {
            return [];
        }
        if (!\is_string($value)) {
            throw JsonApiException::badRequest('The sort parameter must be a comma separated list of fields.', 'sort');
        }

        $sorts = [];
        foreach (explode(',', $value) as $item) {
            $descending = str_starts_with($item, '-');
            $field = $descending ? substr($item, 1) : $item;
            if (!isset($fields[$field])) {
                throw JsonApiException::badRequest(sprintf('Unknown sort field "%s".', $field), 'sort');
            }
            $sorts[] = [$field, $descending ? 'DESC' : 'ASC'];
        }

        return $sorts;
    }

    /**
     * @param list<string> $allowed the relationship names that can be included
     *
     * @return list<string>
     */
    public static function include(Request $request, array $allowed): array
    {
        $value = $request->query->get('include');
        if (null === $value) {
            return [];
        }
        if (!\is_string($value)) {
            throw JsonApiException::badRequest('The include parameter must be a comma separated list of relationships.', 'include');
        }

        $includes = explode(',', $value);
        foreach ($includes as $include) {
            if (!\in_array($include, $allowed, true)) {
                throw JsonApiException::badRequest(sprintf('Unknown include path "%s".', $include), 'include');
            }
        }

        return $includes;
    }

    /**
     * Reads the value of a filter[...] parameter, or null when it is absent.
     */
    public static function filter(Request $request, string $name): ?string
    {
        $filters = $request->query->all('filter');
        if (!\array_key_exists($name, $filters)) {
            return null;
        }
        if (!\is_string($filters[$name])) {
            throw JsonApiException::badRequest(sprintf('The filter[%s] parameter must be a single value.', $name), 'filter['.$name.']');
        }

        return $filters[$name];
    }

    public static function integerFilter(Request $request, string $name): ?int
    {
        $value = self::filter($request, $name);
        if (null === $value) {
            return null;
        }
        if (!preg_match('/^-?\d{1,18}$/', $value)) {
            throw JsonApiException::badRequest(sprintf('The filter[%s] parameter must be an integer.', $name), 'filter['.$name.']');
        }

        return (int) $value;
    }

    public static function booleanFilter(Request $request, string $name): ?bool
    {
        $value = self::filter($request, $name);

        return match ($value) {
            null => null,
            'true' => true,
            'false' => false,
            default => throw JsonApiException::badRequest(sprintf('The filter[%s] parameter must be true or false.', $name), 'filter['.$name.']'),
        };
    }

    public static function dateFilter(Request $request, string $name): ?string
    {
        $value = self::filter($request, $name);
        if (null === $value) {
            return null;
        }

        return self::checkDate($value) ?? throw JsonApiException::badRequest(sprintf('The filter[%s] parameter must be a date, YYYY-MM-DD.', $name), 'filter['.$name.']');
    }

    /**
     * A required date query parameter, YYYY-MM-DD.
     */
    public static function requiredDate(Request $request, string $name): \DateTimeImmutable
    {
        $value = $request->query->get($name);
        if (null === $value || '' === $value) {
            throw JsonApiException::badRequest(sprintf('The %s parameter is required.', $name), $name);
        }
        if (!\is_string($value) || null === self::checkDate($value)) {
            throw JsonApiException::badRequest(sprintf('The %s parameter must be a date, YYYY-MM-DD.', $name), $name);
        }

        return new \DateTimeImmutable($value, new \DateTimeZone('UTC'));
    }

    private static function checkDate(string $value): ?string
    {
        if (!preg_match('/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/', $value, $matches) || !checkdate((int) $matches[2], (int) $matches[3], (int) $matches[1])) {
            return null;
        }

        return $value;
    }

    /**
     * @param array<mixed> $parameters the parameters of a nested parameter, such as page
     */
    private static function integer(array $parameters, string $key, string $name, int $min, int $max): ?int
    {
        if (!\array_key_exists($key, $parameters)) {
            return null;
        }

        $value = $parameters[$key];
        if (!\is_string($value) || !preg_match('/^\d{1,18}$/', $value) || (int) $value < $min || (int) $value > $max) {
            throw JsonApiException::badRequest(sprintf('The %s parameter must be an integer between %d and %d.', $name, $min, $max), $name);
        }

/**
 * Replaces the pagination links and meta of collection documents with the page[number]
 * and page[size] links of the bookshop, keeping every other query parameter.
 */
#[AsDecorator(decorates: 'api_platform.jsonapi.normalizer.collection')]
final class PaginationDocumentNormalizer implements NormalizerInterface, NormalizerAwareInterface
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly NormalizerInterface&NormalizerAwareInterface $inner,
        private readonly RequestStack $requestStack,
    ) {
    }

    public function setNormalizer(NormalizerInterface $normalizer): void
    {
        $this->inner->setNormalizer($normalizer);
    }

    public function normalize(mixed $object, ?string $format = null, array $context = []): array|string|int|float|bool|\ArrayObject|null
    {
        $document = $this->inner->normalize($object, $format, $context);

        $request = $this->requestStack->getCurrentRequest();
        if (!$object instanceof Paginator || !\is_array($document) || null === $request) {
            return $document;

        $page = (int) $object->getCurrentPage();
        $size = (int) $object->getItemsPerPage();

            'first' => $link(1),
            'last' => $link($lastPage),

        }
        if ($page < $lastPage) {
            $links['next'] = $link($page + 1);
        }

        $document['links'] = $links;
        $document['meta'] = ['totalItems' => (int) $object->getTotalItems()];

        return $document;
    }

    }

{
    /**

    public static function data(Request $request, string $type): array
    {

use App\JsonApi\JsonApiException;
use Symfony\Contracts\HttpClient\Exception\ExceptionInterface as HttpClientException;
use Symfony\Contracts\HttpClient\HttpClientInterface;

/**
 * Asks the external payment service to accept or decline a payment.
 */
final class PaymentService
{
    private const URL = 'http://127.0.0.1:18090/payments';

    public function __construct(private readonly HttpClientInterface $httpClient)
    {
    }

    /**
     * @return bool true when the payment is accepted, false when it is declined
     *
     * @throws JsonApiException 502 when the payment service is unreachable or does not answer as expected
     */
    public function charge(int $customerId, int $amountCents): bool
    {
        try {
            $response = $this->httpClient->request('POST', self::URL, [
                'json' => ['customerId' => $customerId, 'amountCents' => $amountCents],
                'timeout' => 5,
            ]);
            $status = $response->getStatusCode();
            $body = $response->getContent(false);
        } catch (HttpClientException) {
            throw self::unavailable();
        }

        $answer = json_decode($body, true);
        if (200 !== $status || !\is_array($answer)) {
            throw self::unavailable();
        }

        return match ($answer['status'] ?? null) {
            'accepted' => true,
            'declined' => false,
            default => throw self::unavailable(),
        };
    }

    private static function unavailable(): JsonApiException
    {
        return JsonApiException::single(502, 'Bad Gateway', 'The payment service did not answer as expected.');
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\State;

use ApiPlatform\Metadata\CollectionOperationInterface;
use ApiPlatform\Metadata\Operation;
use ApiPlatform\State\ProviderInterface;
use App\ApiResource\Author;
use App\ApiResource\Book;
use App\JsonApi\JsonApiException;
use App\JsonApi\Paginator;
use App\JsonApi\Query;
use Doctrine\DBAL\ArrayParameterType;
use Doctrine\DBAL\Connection;

/**
 * @implements ProviderInterface<Author>
 */
final class AuthorProvider implements ProviderInterface
{
    private const SELECT = <<<'SQL'
        SELECT a.id, a.name,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM book pb WHERE pb.author_id = a.id AND pb.published) AS published_books
        FROM author a
        SQL;

    public function __construct(private readonly Connection $connection)
    {
    }

    public function provide(Operation $operation, array $uriVariables = [], array $context = []): object|array|null
    {
        $request = $context['request'];

        if ($operation instanceof CollectionOperationInterface) {
            [$number, $size] = Query::page($request);

            $total = (int) $this->connection->fetchOne('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM author');
            $rows = $this->connection->fetchAllAssociative(
                self::SELECT.' ORDER BY a.id LIMIT ? OFFSET ?',
                [$size, ($number - 1) * $size],
            );

            $authors = array_map($this->hydrate(...), $rows);
            $this->loadBooks($authors);

            return new Paginator($authors, $total, $number, $size);
        }

        $includes = Query::include($request, ['books']);
        $id = (int) $uriVariables['id'];

        $row = $this->connection->fetchAssociative(self::SELECT.' WHERE a.id = ?', [$id]);
        if (false === $row) {
            throw JsonApiException::single(404, 'Not Found', sprintf('Author %d does not exist.', $id));
        }

        $author = $this->hydrate($row);
        $this->loadBooks([$author]);

        if ($includes) {
            $request->attributes->set('_api_included', $includes);
        }

        return $author;
    }

    /**
     * Fills the books relationship of the authors with their published books, in id order.
     *
     * @param list<Author> $authors
     */
    public function loadBooks(array $authors): void
    {
        if ([] === $authors) {
            return;
        }

        $authorsById = [];
        foreach ($authors as $author) {
            $authorsById[$author->id] = $author;
        }

        $rows = $this->connection->fetchAllAssociative(
            'SELECT id, title, price_cents, published_at, stock, author_id FROM book WHERE published = true AND author_id IN (?) ORDER BY id',
            [array_keys($authorsById)],
            [ArrayParameterType::INTEGER],
        );

        foreach ($rows as $row) {
            $author = $authorsById[(int) $row['author_id']];

            $book = new Book();
            $book->id = (int) $row['id'];
            $book->title = $row['title'];
            $book->priceCents = (int) $row['price_cents'];
            $book->publishedAt = $row['published_at'];
            $book->stock = (int) $row['stock'];
            $book->author = $author;

            $author->books[] = $book;
        }
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, mixed> $row
     */
    private function hydrate(array $row): Author
    {
        $author = new Author();
        $author->id = (int) $row['id'];
        $author->name = $row['name'];
        $author->publishedBooks = (int) $row['published_books'];

        return $author;
    }
}

    {

        if ($operation instanceof CollectionOperationInterface) {
            [$number, $size] = Query::page($request);

            $total = (int) $this->connection->fetchOne('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM author');
            $rows = $this->connection->fetchAllAssociative(
                self::SELECT.' ORDER BY a.id LIMIT ? OFFSET ?',
                [$size, ($number - 1) * $size],
            );

            $authors = array_map($this->hydrate(...), $rows);
            $this->loadBooks($authors);

<?php

namespace App\State;

use ApiPlatform\Metadata\Operation;
use ApiPlatform\State\ProcessorInterface;
use App\ApiResource\Book;
use App\JsonApi\JsonApiException;
use App\JsonApi\RequestDocument;
use Doctrine\DBAL\Connection;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;

/**
 * @implements ProcessorInterface<Book, Book|Response>
 */
final class BookProcessor implements ProcessorInterface
{
    /** The attributes that can be changed, with their column. */
    private const COLUMNS = [
        'title' => 'title',
        'priceCents' => 'price_cents',
        'stock' => 'stock',
    ];

    public function __construct(
        private readonly Connection $connection,
        private readonly BookProvider $books,
    ) {
    }

    public function process(mixed $data, Operation $operation, array $uriVariables = [], array $context = []): Book|Response
    {
        $request = $context['request'];
        $id = (int) $uriVariables['id'];

        if (!$data instanceof Book) {
            throw JsonApiException::single(404, 'Not Found', sprintf('Book %d does not exist.', $id));
        }

        $resource = RequestDocument::data($request, 'books');
        if (!isset($resource['id'])) {
            throw JsonApiException::single(400, 'Bad Request', 'The resource object must have an id.', '/data/id');
        }
        if ((string) $resource['id'] !== (string) $id) {
            throw JsonApiException::single(409, 'Conflict', sprintf('The id of the resource (%s) does not match the id of the URL (%d).', $resource['id'], $id), '/data/id');
        }

        $attributes = RequestDocument::attributes($resource);
        $violations = $this->violations($attributes);
        if ([] !== $violations) {
            throw JsonApiException::unprocessable($violations);
        }

        $changes = array_intersect_key($attributes, self::COLUMNS);
        if ([] !== $changes) {
            $assignments = [];
            $values = [];
            foreach ($changes as $name => $value) {
                $assignments[] = self::COLUMNS[$name].' = ?';
                $values[] = $value;
            }
            $values[] = $id;

            $this->connection->executeStatement(
                'UPDATE book SET '.implode(', ', $assignments).' WHERE id = ?',
                $values,
            );
        }

        $book = $this->books->find($id, false);
        if (null === $book) {
            throw JsonApiException::single(404, 'Not Found', sprintf('Book %d does not exist.', $id));
        }

        return $this->isPublished($id) ? $book : new Response('', 204);
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, mixed> $attributes
     *
     * @return list<array{pointer: string, detail: string}>
     */
    private function violations(array $attributes): array
    {
        $violations = [];

        if (\array_key_exists('title', $attributes) && (!\is_string($attributes['title']) || '' === trim($attributes['title']))) {
            $violations[] = ['pointer' => '/data/attributes/title', 'detail' => 'The title must be a non-empty string.'];
        }
        foreach (['priceCents', 'stock'] as $name) {
            if (\array_key_exists($name, $attributes) && (!\is_int($attributes[$name]) || $attributes[$name] < 0)) {
                $violations[] = ['pointer' => '/data/attributes/'.$name, 'detail' => sprintf('The %s must be an integer greater than or equal to 0.', $name)];
            }
        }

        return $violations;
    }

    private function isPublished(int $id): bool
    {
        return (bool) $this->connection->fetchOne('SELECT published FROM book WHERE id = ?', [$id]);

/**
 * @implements ProcessorInterface<Book, Book|Response>
 */
final class BookProcessor implements ProcessorInterface
{
    /** The attributes that can be changed, with their column. */
    private const COLUMNS = [
        'title' => 'title',
        'priceCents' => 'price_cents',
        'stock' => 'stock',
    ];

    public function __construct(
        private readonly Connection $connection,
        private readonly BookProvider $books,
    ) {
    }

    public function process(mixed $data, Operation $operation, array $uriVariables = [], array $context = []): Book|Response
    {
        $request = $context['request'];
        $id = (int) $uriVariables['id'];

        if (!$data instanceof Book) {
            throw JsonApiException::single(404, 'Not Found', sprintf('Book %d does not exist.', $id));
        }

        $resource = RequestDocument::data($request, 'books');
        if (!isset($resource['id'])) {
            throw JsonApiException::single(400, 'Bad Request', 'The resource object must have an id.', '/data/id');
        }
        if ((string) $resource['id'] !== (string) $id) {
            throw JsonApiException::single(409, 'Conflict', sprintf('The id of the resource (%s) does not match the id of the URL (%d).', $resource['id'], $id), '/data/id');
        }

        $attributes = RequestDocument::attributes($resource);
        $violations = $this->violations($attributes);
        if ([] !== $violations) {
            throw JsonApiException::unprocessable($violations);
        }

        $changes = array_intersect_key($attributes, self::COLUMNS);
        if ([] !== $changes) {
            $assignments = [];
            $values = [];
            foreach ($changes as $name => $value) {
                $assignments[] = self::COLUMNS[$name].' = ?';
                $values[] = $value;
            }
            $values[] = $id;

            $this->connection->executeStatement(
                'UPDATE book SET '.implode(', ', $assignments).' WHERE id = ?',
                $values,
            );
        }

        $book = $this->books->find($id, false);
        if (null === $book) {
            throw JsonApiException::single(404, 'Not Found', sprintf('Book %d does not exist.', $id));
        }

        return $this->isPublished($id) ? $book : new Response('', 204);
    }

 *
 * @implements ProcessorInterface<mixed, Purchase>

final class PurchaseProcessor implements ProcessorInterface
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly Connection $connection,
        private readonly PaymentService $payment,
        private readonly PurchaseProvider $purchases,
    ) {
    }

    public function process(mixed $data, Operation $operation, array $uriVariables = [], array $context = []): Purchase
    {
        $request = $context['request'];
        $customerId = (int) $request->attributes->get(CustomerIdentificationListener::ATTRIBUTE);

        $attributes = RequestDocument::attributes(RequestDocument::data($request, 'purchases'));
        $lines = $this->lines($attributes['lines'] ?? null);

        return $this->connection->transactional(function (Connection $connection) use ($customerId, $lines): Purchase {
            $books = $this->lockBooks($lines);

            $total = 0;
            $quantities = [];
            foreach ($lines as $index => $line) {
                $book = $books[$line['bookId']];
                if (null === $book || !$book['published']) {
                    throw JsonApiException::unprocessable([[
                        'pointer' => sprintf('/data/attributes/lines/%d/bookId', $index),
                        'detail' => 'The book must be a published book.',
                    ]]);
                }

                $quantities[$line['bookId']] = ($quantities[$line['bookId']] ?? 0) + $line['quantity'];
                $total += $line['quantity'] * $book['price_cents'];
            }

            foreach ($quantities as $bookId => $quantity) {
                if ($quantity > $books[$bookId]['stock']) {
                    throw JsonApiException::single(409, 'Conflict', sprintf('Not enough stock for book %d: %d asked, %d available.', $bookId, $quantity, $books[$bookId]['stock']));
                }
            }

                throw JsonApiException::single(402, 'Payment Required', 'The payment was declined.');

                'INSERT INTO purchase (customer_id, created_at, total_cents) VALUES (?, now(), ?) RETURNING id, created_at, total_cents',

            }

            return $this->purchases->withLines([$purchase])[0];
        });
    }

            if (!\is_int($line['quantity'] ?? null) || $line['quantity'] < 1) {
                throw JsonApiException::unprocessable([['pointer' => sprintf('/data/attributes/lines/%d/quantity', $index), 'detail' => 'The quantity must be an integer greater than or equal to 1.']]);
            }

            $result[] = ['bookId' => $line['bookId'], 'quantity' => $line['quantity']];
        }

        return $result;
    }

    /**
     * @param list<array{bookId: int, quantity: int}> $lines
     *
     * @return array<int, array{title: string, price_cents: int, published: bool, stock: int}|null> the books, by id, locked until the end of the transaction
     */
    private function lockBooks(array $lines): array
    {
        $ids = array_values(array_unique(array_column($lines, 'bookId')));
        $rows = $this->connection->fetchAllAssociative(
            'SELECT id, title, price_cents, published, stock FROM book WHERE id IN (?) ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE',

                'published' => (bool) $row['published'],
                'stock' => (int) $row['stock'],
            ];
        }

        return $books;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\State;

use ApiPlatform\Metadata\Operation;
use ApiPlatform\State\ProviderInterface;
use App\JsonApi\JsonApiException;
use App\JsonApi\Query;
use Doctrine\DBAL\Connection;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;

/**
 * The books sold between two days, as a CSV file (RFC 4180).
 */
final class SalesReportProvider implements ProviderInterface
{
    public function __construct(private readonly Connection $connection)
    {
    }

    public function provide(Operation $operation, array $uriVariables = [], array $context = []): Response
    {
        $request = $context['request'];
        $from = Query::requiredDate($request, 'from');
        $to = Query::requiredDate($request, 'to');
        if ($from > $to) {
            throw JsonApiException::badRequest('The from parameter must not be after the to parameter.', 'from');
        }

        // The whole of the last day is included: the period ends before the next day.
        $rows = $this->connection->fetchAllAssociative(
            'SELECT b.id, b.title, SUM(pl.quantity) AS quantity, SUM(pl.quantity * pl.unit_price_cents) AS revenue_cents
             FROM purchase_line pl
             JOIN purchase p ON p.id = pl.purchase_id
             JOIN book b ON b.id = pl.book_id
             WHERE p.created_at >= ? AND p.created_at < ?
             GROUP BY b.id, b.title
             ORDER BY revenue_cents DESC, b.title ASC, b.id ASC',
            [$from->format('Y-m-d 00:00:00+00'), $to->modify('+1 day')->format('Y-m-d 00:00:00+00')],
        );

        $csv = self::line(['title', 'quantity', 'revenueCents']);
        foreach ($rows as $row) {
            $csv .= self::line([$row['title'], (int) $row['quantity'], (int) $row['revenue_cents']]);
        }

        return new Response($csv, 200, [
            'Content-Type' => 'text/csv',
            'Content-Disposition' => sprintf('attachment; filename="sales-%s-%s.csv"', $from->format('Y-m-d'), $to->format('Y-m-d')),
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * @param list<string|int> $fields
     */
    private static function line(array $fields): string
    {
        return implode(',', array_map(static function (string|int $field): string {
            $field = (string) $field;

            return preg_match('/[",\r\n]/', $field) ? '"'.str_replace('"', '""', $field).'"' : $field;
        }, $fields))."\r\n";
    }
}

        $csv = self::line(['title', 'quantity', 'revenueCents']);
        foreach ($rows as $row) {
            $csv .= self::line([$row['title'], (int) $row['quantity'], (int) $row['revenue_cents']]);
        }

        return new Response($csv, 200, [
            'Content-Type' => 'text/csv',
            'Content-Disposition' => sprintf('attachment; filename="sales-%s-%s.csv"', $from->format('Y-m-d'), $to->format('Y-m-d')),
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * @param list<string|int> $fields
     */
    private static function line(array $fields): string
    {
        return implode(',', array_map(static function (string|int $field): string {
            $field = (string) $field;

            return preg_match('/[",\r\n]/', $field) ? '"'.str_replace('"', '""', $field).'"' : $field;
        }, $fields))."\r\n";
    }
}

namespace ApiPlatform\Symfony\Action;
final class DocumentationAction
{
    use ContentNegotiationTrait;
    public function __construct(
        private readonly ResourceNameCollectionFactoryInterface $resourceNameCollectionFactory,
        private readonly string $title = '',
        private readonly string $description = '',
        private readonly string $version = '',
        private readonly ?OpenApiFactoryInterface $openApiFactory = null,
        private readonly ?ProviderInterface $provider = null,
        private readonly ?ProcessorInterface $processor = null,
        ?Negotiator $negotiator = null,
        private readonly array $documentationFormats = [OpenApiNormalizer::JSON_FORMAT => ['application/vnd.openapi+json'], OpenApiNormalizer::FORMAT => ['application/json']],
        private readonly bool $swaggerUiEnabled = true,
        private readonly bool $docsEnabled = true,
        private readonly bool $reDocEnabled = true,
        private readonly bool $scalarEnabled = true,
    ) {
        $this->negotiator = $negotiator ?? new Negotiator();
    }
    public function __invoke(?Request $request = null)
    {
        if (false === $this->docsEnabled) {
            throw new NotFoundHttpException();
        }
        if (null === $request) {
            return new Documentation($this->resourceNameCollectionFactory->create(), $this->title, $this->description, $this->version);
        }
        $context = [
            'api_gateway' => $request->query->getBoolean(ApiGatewayNormalizer::API_GATEWAY),
            'base_url' => $request->getBaseUrl(),
            'spec_version' => (string) $request->query->get(LegacyOpenApiNormalizer::SPEC_VERSION),
            'filter_tags' => $request->query->all('filter_tags'),
        ];
        $request->attributes->set('_api_normalization_context', $request->attributes->get('_api_normalization_context', []) + $context);
        $this->addRequestFormats($request, $this->documentationFormats);
        $format = $this->getRequestFormat($request, $this->documentationFormats);
        if (null !== $this->openApiFactory && ('html' === $format || OpenApiNormalizer::FORMAT === $format || OpenApiNormalizer::JSON_FORMAT === $format || OpenApiNormalizer::YAML_FORMAT === $format)) {
            return $this->getOpenApiDocumentation($context, $format, $request);
        }
        return $this->getHydraDocumentation($context, $request);
    }
    private function getOpenApiDocumentation(array $context, string $format, Request $request): OpenApi|Response
    {
        if ('html' === $format && !$this->swaggerUiEnabled && !$this->reDocEnabled && !$this->scalarEnabled) {
            throw new NotFoundHttpException('Swagger UI, ReDoc and Scalar are disabled.');
        }
        if ($this->provider && $this->processor) {
            $context['request'] = $request;
            $operation = new Get(
                class: OpenApi::class,
                read: true,
                serialize: true,
                provider: 'api_platform.openapi.provider',
                outputFormats: $this->documentationFormats
            );
            if ('html' === $format && ($this->swaggerUiEnabled || $this->reDocEnabled || $this->scalarEnabled)) {
                $operation = $operation->withProcessor('api_platform.swagger_ui.processor')->withWrite(true);
            }
            return $this->processor->process($this->provider->provide($operation, [], $context), $operation, [], $context);
        }
        return $this->openApiFactory->__invoke($context);
    }
    private function getHydraDocumentation(array $context, Request $request): DocumentationInterface|Response
    {
        if ($this->provider && $this->processor) {
            $context['request'] = $request;
            $operation = new Get(
                class: Documentation::class,
                read: true,
                serialize: true,
                provider: fn () => new Documentation($this->resourceNameCollectionFactory->create(), $this->title, $this->description, $this->version)
            );
            return $this->processor->process($this->provider->provide($operation, [], $context), $operation, [], $context);
        }
        return new Documentation($this->resourceNameCollectionFactory->create(), $this->title, $this->description, $this->version);
    }

<?php

namespace App\Controller;

use ApiPlatform\OpenApi\Factory\OpenApiFactoryInterface;
use ApiPlatform\OpenApi\Serializer\OpenApiNormalizer;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;
use Symfony\Component\Routing\Attribute\Route;
use Symfony\Component\Serializer\SerializerInterface;

/**
 * Serves the OpenAPI document generated by API Platform for every operation of the API.
 */
final class OpenApiController
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly OpenApiFactoryInterface $openApiFactory,
        private readonly SerializerInterface $serializer,
    ) {
    }

    #[Route('/openapi.json', name: 'openapi', methods: ['GET'])]
    public function __invoke(): Response
    {
        $document = ($this->openApiFactory)([]);
        $json = $this->serializer->serialize($document, OpenApiNormalizer::JSON_FORMAT, ['spec_version' => '3.1.0']);

        return new Response($json, 200, ['Content-Type' => 'application/json']);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\JsonApi;

use ApiPlatform\State\Pagination\PaginatorInterface;

/**
 * A page of a collection, with the total number of items across all pages.
 */
final class Paginator implements PaginatorInterface
{
    /**
     * @param list<object> $items the items of the current page
     */
    public function __construct(
        private readonly array $items,
        private readonly int $totalItems,
        private readonly int $page,
        private readonly int $size,
    ) {
    }

    public function getLastPage(): float
    {
        return (float) max(1, (int) ceil($this->totalItems / $this->size));
    }

    public function getTotalItems(): float
    {
        return (float) $this->totalItems;
    }

    public function getCurrentPage(): float
    {
        return (float) $this->page;
    }

    public function getItemsPerPage(): float
    {
        return (float) $this->size;
    }

    public function count(): int
    {
        return \count($this->items);
    }

    public function getIterator(): \Traversable
    {
        return new \ArrayIterator($this->items);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\JsonApi;

use Symfony\Component\DependencyInjection\Attribute\AsDecorator;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\RequestStack;
use Symfony\Component\Serializer\Normalizer\NormalizerAwareInterface;
use Symfony\Component\Serializer\Normalizer\NormalizerInterface;

/**
 * Replaces the pagination links and meta of collection documents with the page[number]
 * and page[size] links of the bookshop, keeping every other query parameter.
 */
#[AsDecorator(decorates: 'api_platform.jsonapi.normalizer.collection')]
final class PaginationDocumentNormalizer implements NormalizerInterface, NormalizerAwareInterface
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly NormalizerInterface&NormalizerAwareInterface $inner,
        private readonly RequestStack $requestStack,
    ) {
    }

    public function setNormalizer(NormalizerInterface $normalizer): void
    {
        $this->inner->setNormalizer($normalizer);
    }

    public function normalize(mixed $object, ?string $format = null, array $context = []): array|string|int|float|bool|\ArrayObject|null
    {
        $document = $this->inner->normalize($object, $format, $context);

        $request = $this->requestStack->getCurrentRequest();
        if (!$object instanceof Paginator || !\is_array($document) || null === $request) {
            return $document;
        }

        $page = (int) $object->getCurrentPage();
        $size = (int) $object->getItemsPerPage();
        $lastPage = (int) $object->getLastPage();
        $query = $request->query->all();
        $link = static fn (int $number): string => $request->getPathInfo().'?'.http_build_query(array_replace($query, [
            'page' => ['number' => $number, 'size' => $size],
        ]));

        $links = [
            'self' => $link($page),
            'first' => $link(1),
            'last' => $link($lastPage),
        ];
        if ($page > 1) {
            $links['prev'] = $link($page - 1);
        }
        if ($page < $lastPage) {
            $links['next'] = $link($page + 1);
        }

        $document['links'] = $links;
        $document['meta'] = ['totalItems' => (int) $object->getTotalItems()];

        return $document;
    }

    public function supportsNormalization(mixed $data, ?string $format = null, array $context = []): bool
    {
        return $this->inner->supportsNormalization($data, $format, $context);
    }

    public function getSupportedTypes(?string $format): array
    {
        return $this->inner->getSupportedTypes($format);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\JsonApi;

use Symfony\Component\DependencyInjection\Attribute\AsDecorator;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\RequestStack;
use Symfony\Component\Serializer\Normalizer\NormalizerAwareInterface;
use Symfony\Component\Serializer\Normalizer\NormalizerInterface;

/**
 * Replaces the pagination links and meta of collection documents with the page[number]
 * and page[size] links of the bookshop, keeping every other query parameter.
 */
#[AsDecorator(decorates: 'api_platform.jsonapi.normalizer.collection')]
final class PaginationDocumentNormalizer implements NormalizerInterface, NormalizerAwareInterface
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly NormalizerInterface $inner,
        private readonly RequestStack $requestStack,
    ) {
    }

    public function setNormalizer(NormalizerInterface $normalizer): void
    {
        if ($this->inner instanceof NormalizerAwareInterface) {
            $this->inner->setNormalizer($normalizer);
        }
    }

    public function normalize(mixed $object, ?string $format = null, array $context = []): array|string|int|float|bool|\ArrayObject|null
    {
        $document = $this->inner->normalize($object, $format, $context);

        $request = $this->requestStack->getCurrentRequest();
        if (!$object instanceof Paginator || !\is_array($document) || null === $request) {
            return $document;
        }

        $page = (int) $object->getCurrentPage();
        $size = (int) $object->getItemsPerPage();
        $lastPage = (int) $object->getLastPage();
        $query = $request->query->all();
        $link = static fn (int $number): string => $request->getPathInfo().'?'.http_build_query(array_replace($query, [
            'page' => ['number' => $number, 'size' => $size],
        ]));

        $links = [
            'self' => $link($page),
            'first' => $link(1),
            'last' => $link($lastPage),
        ];
        if ($page > 1) {
            $links['prev'] = $link($page - 1);
        }
        if ($page < $lastPage) {
            $links['next'] = $link($page + 1);
        }

        $document['links'] = $links;
        $document['meta'] = ['totalItems' => (int) $object->getTotalItems()];

        return $document;
    }

    public function supportsNormalization(mixed $data, ?string $format = null, array $context = []): bool
    {
        return $this->inner->supportsNormalization($data, $format, $context);
    }

    public function getSupportedTypes(?string $format): array
    {
        return $this->inner->getSupportedTypes($format);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\JsonApi;

use Symfony\Component\EventDispatcher\Attribute\AsEventListener;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\JsonResponse;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;
use Symfony\Component\HttpKernel\Event\ExceptionEvent;
use Symfony\Component\HttpKernel\Exception\HttpExceptionInterface;
use Symfony\Component\HttpKernel\KernelEvents;

/**
 * Renders the errors of the API as JSON:API error documents.
 */
#[AsEventListener(event: KernelEvents::EXCEPTION, priority: 128)]
final class ErrorListener
{
    private const API_PATH = '#^/(books|authors|purchases|reports|openapi\.json)(/|$)#';

    public function __invoke(ExceptionEvent $event): void
    {
        if (!preg_match(self::API_PATH, $event->getRequest()->getPathInfo())) {
            return;
        }

        $throwable = $event->getThrowable();

        if ($throwable instanceof JsonApiException) {
            $status = $throwable->status;
            $errors = $throwable->errors;
        } elseif ($throwable instanceof HttpExceptionInterface) {
            $status = $throwable->getStatusCode();
            $errors = [JsonApiException::error($status, Response::$statusTexts[$status] ?? 'Error', $throwable->getMessage() ?: (Response::$statusTexts[$status] ?? 'Error'))];
        } else {
            $status = 500;
            $errors = [JsonApiException::error(500, 'Internal Server Error', 'An unexpected error occurred.')];
        }

        $event->setResponse(new JsonResponse(['errors' => $errors], $status, ['Content-Type' => 'application/vnd.api+json']));
        $event->stopPropagation();
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\JsonApi;

use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Request;

/**
 * Reads the primary data of a JSON:API request document.
 */
final class RequestDocument
{
    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed> the "data" member of the document, of the given resource type
     */
    public static function data(Request $request, string $type): array
    {
        try {
            $document = json_decode($request->getContent(), true, 512, \JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
        } catch (\JsonException) {
            throw JsonApiException::badRequest('The request body is not valid JSON.');
        }

        if (!\is_array($document) || !isset($document['data']) || !\is_array($document['data']) || array_is_list($document['data'])) {
            throw JsonApiException::single(400, 'Bad Request', 'The request body must be a JSON:API document with a "data" object.', '/data');
        }

        $data = $document['data'];
        if (($data['type'] ?? null) !== $type) {
            throw JsonApiException::single(409, 'Conflict', sprintf('The resource type must be "%s".', $type), '/data/type');
        }

        return $data;
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, mixed> $data
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed> the attributes of the resource object
     */
    public static function attributes(array $data): array
    {
        $attributes = $data['attributes'] ?? [];
        if (!\is_array($attributes) || array_is_list($attributes)) {
            throw JsonApiException::single(400, 'Bad Request', 'The attributes must be a JSON object.', '/data/attributes');
        }

        return $attributes;
    }
}

content.text: PHP attributes can't call methods like `Docs::error()`, so the `openapi:` option in the resource attributes won't compile. I'll move the request bodies and error responses into a document-level step that runs on the generated OpenAPI array in the controller. That keeps the attributes simple and still gives every operation its bodies and responses.

/**

final class Documentation
{
    private const JSON_API = 'application/vnd.api+json';

    /**
     * @param array<string, mixed> $document
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public static function apply(array $document): array
    {
        $errorResponse = static fn (string $description): array => [
            'description' => $description,
            'content' => [self::JSON_API => ['schema' => self::errorSchema()]],
        ];

        self::addResponses($document, '/books', 'get', ['400' => $errorResponse('An invalid query parameter.')]);
        self::addResponses($document, '/books/{id}', 'get', [
            '400' => $errorResponse('An invalid include parameter.'),
            '404' => $errorResponse('No published book has this id.'),
        ]);
        self::addRequestBody($document, '/books/{id}', 'patch', self::bookPatchBody(), [
            '204' => ['description' => 'The book is not published: nothing to return.'],
            '404' => $errorResponse('No book has this id.'),
            '409' => $errorResponse('The id of the body is not the id of the URL.'),
            '415' => $errorResponse('The Content-Type is not application/vnd.api+json.'),
            '422' => $errorResponse('Invalid attributes: nothing is changed.'),
        ]);

        self::addResponses($document, '/authors', 'get', ['400' => $errorResponse('An invalid query parameter.')]);
        self::addResponses($document, '/authors/{id}', 'get', [
            '400' => $errorResponse('An invalid include parameter.'),
            '404' => $errorResponse('Unknown author.'),
        ]);

        self::addResponses($document, '/purchases', 'get', [
            '400' => $errorResponse('An invalid query parameter.'),
            '401' => $errorResponse('The Customer-Id header is missing, malformed or unknown.'),
        ]);
        self::addResponses($document, '/purchases/{id}', 'get', [
            '401' => $errorResponse('The Customer-Id header is missing, malformed or unknown.'),
            '404' => $errorResponse("No purchase of this customer has this id."),
        ]);
        self::addRequestBody($document, '/purchases', 'post', self::purchasePostBody(), [
            '401' => $errorResponse('The Customer-Id header is missing, malformed or unknown.'),

content.text:
The Bookshop API is built and served on port 8089 via `./start.sh`, and I've left it stopped. I tested it by hand with curl; I did not add an automated test suite.

**How it's built**
- API Platform 5 resources for `authors`, `books`, `purchases` and the sales report, with JSON:API serialization from `api-platform/json-api`. I added that package and `symfony/http-client` to `composer.json`.
- Reads and writes go through state providers and processors that use DBAL SQL against the existing tables. There are no entities and no migrations, so the schema is untouched.
- Two things needed custom handling: the package's pagination emits `page=` links, so a decorator rewrites them to `page[number]`/`page[size]` and `meta.totalItems`. Error responses are rendered as JSON:API error documents by a kernel listener on the API paths.
- `GET /openapi.json` serves the API Platform document, plus request bodies and error responses that a small post-processing step adds.
- `.env.local` holds the DSN you gave; `start.sh` runs `php -S` in the prod environment in the foreground.

**Choices I made where the spec was open**
- OpenAPI is emitted as **3.0.0**. This API Platform release defaults to 3.2, which the spec doesn't allow.
- A declined payment (HTTP 200, `{"status":"declined"}`) gives 402. A non-200 answer or an unknown status gives 502. The payment service returns 500 for customer 3, so that customer exercises the 502 path.
- Title sorting uses the database collation (`en_US.utf8`). CSV lines end in CRLF and the `Content-Type` is `text/csv; charset=UTF-8` (Symfony appends the charset).
- A bookId sent as a string (`"1"`) is rejected with 422, since the spec says integers.
- A PATCH body with no `data.id` gets 400; a mismatched id gets 409.

**What I verified**
- Every endpoint in the spec, including the 400, 401, 404, 409, 415, 422, 402 and 502 paths, the 204 for unpublished PATCH, the boundary dates in the report, the anonymous author's `name: null`, and the pagination links.

The Bookshop API is built and served on port 8089 via `./start.sh`, and I've left it stopped. I tested it by hand with curl; I did not add an automated test suite.

**How it's built**
- API Platform 5 resources for `authors`, `books`, `purchases` and the sales report, with JSON:API serialization from `api-platform/json-api`. I added that package and `symfony/http-client` to `composer.json`.
- Reads and writes go through state providers and processors that use DBAL SQL against the existing tables. There are no entities and no migrations, so the schema is untouched.
- Two things needed custom handling: the package's pagination emits `page=` links, so a decorator rewrites them to `page[number]`/`page[size]` and `meta.totalItems`. Error responses are rendered as JSON:API error documents by a kernel listener on the API paths.
- `GET /openapi.json` serves the API Platform document, plus request bodies and error responses that a small post-processing step adds.
- `.env.local` holds the DSN you gave; `start.sh` runs `php -S` in the prod environment in the foreground.

**Choices I made where the spec was open**
- OpenAPI is emitted as **3.0.0**. This API Platform release defaults to 3.2, which the spec doesn't allow.
- A declined payment (HTTP 200, `{"status":"declined"}`) gives 402. A non-200 answer or an unknown status gives 502. The payment service returns 500 for customer 3, so that customer exercises the 502 path.
- Title sorting uses the database collation (`en_US.utf8`). CSV lines end in CRLF and the `Content-Type` is `text/csv; charset=UTF-8` (Symfony appends the charset).
- A bookId sent as a string (`"1"`) is rejected with 422, since the spec says integers.
- A PATCH body with no `data.id` gets 400; a mismatched id gets 409.
